description_en: To modify an existing load balancer, you must specify its load balancer ID
description_zh: 修改已有的负载均衡器信息，需要带上负载均衡器ID来标识要修改哪个负载均衡器
name: UpdateLoadBalancer

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the load balancer is enabled.

`true`: The load balancer is enabled.

`false`: The load balancer is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡器是否启用。

true：启用。
false：不启用
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Site. You can obtain this ID by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) API operation
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform origin-pull across address pools.

`true`: Enables origin-pull across address pools.

`false`: Disables origin-pull across address pools
fields.help_zh:
是否跨地址池回源。

true：是。
false: 否
fields.name: failover_across_pools

fields.help_en: The OriginLevelRetry
fields.help_zh: The OriginLevelRetry
fields.name: origin_level_retry

parameters.help_en: Configures origin-pull behavior across address pools
parameters.name: adaptive_routing

parameters.help_en: A list of default address pool IDs
parameters.name: default_pools

parameters.help_en: The ID of the fallback address pool. Traffic is routed to this pool when all other address pools are unavailable
parameters.help_zh: 兜底地址池ID，当所有其他池不可用时，流量将被导向此处
parameters.name: fallback_pool

fields.help_en: The default weight applied to all address pools that do not have a specific weight defined. The value must be an integer from 0 to 100, inclusive
fields.help_zh: 默认的轮询权重，用于所有没有单独指定权重的地址池。取值范围：0-100之间的整数
fields.name: default_weight

fields.help_en: A map of pool IDs to their corresponding weights. These weights determine the proportion of traffic routed to each backend server pool
fields.help_zh: 各后端服务器池的权重配置，键为池ID，值为权重系数。权重系数表示相对流量分配的比例
fields.name: pool_weights

parameters.help_en: The configuration for weighted round-robin. This setting controls the weight of traffic distributed to different address pools
parameters.help_zh: 加权轮询配置，用于控制不同地址池的流量分配权重
parameters.name: random_steering

fields.help_en: The value of the `Content-Type` field in the HTTP response header
fields.help_zh: HTTP Header中的Content-Type字段
fields.name: content_type

fields.help_en: The value of the `Location` field in the HTTP response header. This is typically used for redirections
fields.help_zh: HTTP 返回中的Location字段
fields.name: location

fields.help_en: The content of the response body
fields.help_zh: 响应Body值
fields.name: message_body

fields.help_en: The HTTP status code of the response
fields.help_zh: 响应状态码
fields.name: status_code

fields.help_en: The fixed response to return when the rule's condition is met
fields.help_zh: 匹配规则后执行响应指定内容
fields.name: fixed_response

fields.help_en: The settings to override for requests that match this rule's condition. These settings take precedence over the load balancer's main configuration
fields.help_zh: 匹配规则后修改对应请求改写的负载均衡配置，配置的字段，会覆盖负载均衡器配置里相应的字段
fields.name: overrides

fields.help_en:
The content of the rule, specified as a conditional expression to match user requests. This parameter is not required when you configure global settings. Use cases:

To match all incoming requests, set the value to `true`.

To match specific requests, set the value to a custom expression, such as `(http.host eq "video.example.com")`
fields.help_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
fields.name: rule

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the rule is enabled. This parameter is not required when you configure global settings. Valid values:

`on`: Enabled.

`off`: Disabled
fields.help_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
fields.name: rule_enable

fields.help_en: The name of the rule. This parameter is not required when you configure global settings
fields.help_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数
fields.name: rule_name

fields.help_en: The execution priority of the rule. This parameter is optional. If you do not specify this parameter, rules are executed in the order they are listed. If specified, the value must be an integer greater than 0. A larger value indicates a higher priority
fields.help_zh: 规则执行顺序，可以不填，不填时以列表顺序执行，如果填的话，是大于0的整数。数值越大越优先执行
fields.name: sequence

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to stop processing subsequent rules after this rule is matched.

`true`: Stop processing subsequent rules.

`false`: Continue processing subsequent rules. This is the default value
fields.help_zh:
是否终止执行后续规则。
true：是。
false：否，默认值
fields.name: terminates

parameters.help_en: A list of rules that define behavior overrides for specific conditions
parameters.help_zh: 规则配置列表，用于定义特定条件下的行为覆盖
parameters.name: rules

parameters.help_en:
The method for session affinity, which ensures that requests from the same client are routed to the same origin server. Valid values:

`off`: Disables session affinity.

`ip`: Enables session affinity based on the client IP address.

`cookie`: Enables session affinity based on a cookie
parameters.help_zh:
会话保持，取值：
off：不开启。
ip：按ip方式会话保持。
cookie: 按cookie方式会话保持
parameters.name: session_affinity

parameters.help_en: The traffic steering policy, which determines how traffic is distributed among the address pools
parameters.name: steering_policy

parameters.help_en: An optional description of the load balancer for easier identification and management
parameters.help_zh: 负载均衡器的详细描述信息，便于管理和识别
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The Time to Live (TTL) for the DNS record, in seconds. The default is 30. The value must be between 10 and 600, inclusive
parameters.help_zh: TTL值，DNS记录的生存时间，默认为30，取值范围：10-600
parameters.name: ttl

fields.help_en: The number of consecutive failed health checks required to declare an origin server unhealthy. For example, `5`
fields.help_zh: 连续探测多少次失败算失败，如5
fields.name: consecutive_down

fields.help_en: The number of consecutive successful health checks required to declare an origin server healthy. For example, `3`
fields.help_zh: 连续探测多少次成功算成功，如3
fields.name: consecutive_up

fields.help_en: The expected HTTP status codes that indicate a healthy response. For example, `200,202`
fields.help_zh: 预期状态码，如200,202，成功的HTTP响应
fields.name: expected_codes

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the health check monitor follows HTTP redirections.

`true`: The monitor follows HTTP redirections.

`false`: The monitor does not follow HTTP redirections
fields.help_zh:
是否跟随重定向。

true：是。
false：否
fields.name: follow_redirects

fields.help_en: The HTTP request headers to send with each health check
fields.help_zh: 监视请求头配置
fields.name: header

fields.help_en: The interval in seconds between each health check. For example, `60`
fields.help_zh: 监视间隔，如60秒，检查频率
fields.name: interval

fields.help_en: The HTTP method to use for the health check. For example, `GET`
fields.help_zh: 监视器请求方法，如GET，HTTP协议中的方法
fields.name: method

fields.help_en:
The regions from which the health checks are performed. The default value is `Global`.

`Global`: From probe locations worldwide.

`ChineseMainland`: From probe locations within the Chinese mainland.

`OutsideChineseMainland`: From probe locations outside the Chinese mainland
fields.help_zh:
探测点所在区域，默认为Global，

Global: 全球。
ChineseMainland: 中国内地。
OutsideChineseMainland: 全球（不包括中国内地）
fields.name: monitoring_region

fields.help_en: The path on the origin server to request for the health check. For example, `/healthcheck`
fields.help_zh: 监视器检查路径，如/healthcheck，HTTP请求路径
fields.name: path

fields.help_en: The port on the origin server to use for the health check
fields.help_zh: 源站端口
fields.name: port

fields.help_en: The timeout for the health check, in seconds. The value must be between 1 and 10, inclusive
fields.help_zh: 应用健康检查超时时间，单位为秒，取值范围：1-10
fields.name: timeout

fields.help_en: The protocol to use for the health check, such as `HTTP`. If you set this to `off`, no health check is performed
fields.help_zh: 监视器协议类型，如HTTP，用于健康检查，值为off时，表示不进行检查
fields.name: type

parameters.help_zh: 监视器配置，用于健康检查
parameters.name: monitor

parameters.help_en: The ID of the load balancer. You can obtain this ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2868897.html API operation
parameters.help_zh: 负载均衡器ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2868897.html接口获取
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: A map of primary regions to their corresponding address pools
parameters.name: region_pools

parameters.help_en: A map of secondary regions to their corresponding address pools. To assign the same address pools to multiple secondary regions, combine their codes into a single, comma-separated key
parameters.help_zh: 二级region对应的地址池，多个二级region共用一批地址池时，可以多个二级region，使用逗号拼接作为key
parameters.name: sub_region_pools

schema.description_en: The structure of the response returned for a successful load balancer update
schema.description_zh: 修改负载均衡器成功后的响应结构
